 Oral Order
 03 / Dated : 12.08.2024

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner named above has moved this Court for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Complaint Case No. 757 of 2019 registered under Sections 498A, 323, 504 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 3/4 of Prevention of Witch (Daain) Practices Act, pending in the court of J.M. 1st Class, Koderma.
Heard the parties.
As per the complaint case, the complainant was married to the petitioner in 2008 and two children were born from the wedlock.
It is alleged that she was badly assaulted on 01.05.2019 for getting up late in the morning and she was also identified as a witch and a dowry demand of Rs. 2 Lakh was also made.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the allegation of dowry demand arising after seven years of marriage is absolutely untenable.
It is further submitted that due to marital discord this complaint has been filed implicating the entire family members, eight in number.
The alleged incident is said to have taken place on 01.05.2019 and the complaint has been filed on 29.05.2019.

Furthermore, as a matter of fact, the complainant was having consensual relationship with another person, and after the dispute arose between them Koderma Jainagar P.S.
Case No. 31 of 2023 was lodged on 22.02.2023 under Sections 376, 312, 323 and 506/34.

The Addl. P.P.,
assisted by learned counsel for the complainant, opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that in 2017 a boy was born from their wedlock and due to lack of treatment, he passed away and after his death, they started imputing her to be a witch resulting this case.
Complainant is ready and willing to live with the petitioner.
Considering the submissions of learned counsel and the fact as discussed above, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

Hence, in the event of his arrest or surrender within a period of two weeks from the date of this order, the petitioner named above shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below, subject to the conditions laid down under section 438 (2)
